private_lines.Maya: You work nights as a paediatric nurse at St James's in Leeds, so this week you are sleeping through the afternoons and trying to catch up with your sister's wedding planning in between shifts.
private_lines.Tom: You run a small bike repair stall at Kirkgate Market and are behind on orders because your landlord has just told you the unit is being sold.
private_lines.Jo: You are a secondary school geography teacher in Headingley, and this week you are marking mock exam papers and dreading the parents' evening on Thursday.
private_lines.Sam: You are a sound engineer at a studio in Hunslet, and this week you are mixing an album for a local folk band whose singer keeps changing the tracklist.
private_lines.Priya: You are a junior solicitor in the city centre on Park Row, and this week you are preparing for a tribunal hearing that starts on Monday and you have barely left the office.
private_lines.Dan: You are a self-employed plasterer working on a Victorian terrace in Chapel Allerton, and this week the owners have asked you to redo a ceiling you already finished.

setting: You all live in Leeds and met years ago through the same climbing gym, and you still keep the group chat going across different parts of the city.
